values.note: Priced per person plus a site charge: adults $14.50 weekdays, $16.50 weekends, $18.50 peak (Jun 12-Aug 9 and events) in the family area, $2 more in the loud area; youth 8-12 $8.50-10.50, children 7 and under free; electric, W&E or full hookup $22 a site. Two adults on a hookup site pay $51-63 before tax. Two-person minimum per site Memorial Day to Labor Day. Visitors $14 a day. Refund (less $35) only 14+ days out.

note: Large float outfitter on the Courtois near Steelville with separate quiet family and late-night loud camping areas, mostly tent sites. The RV sites sit back from the creek behind tent sites. Camping is charged per person, and the campground floods at times. --Claude
summary: Added 2026 per-person pricing ($51-63 for two adults on a hookup site), 30/50A hookups, Ridgeview pull-throughs, bathhouses/dump/store, year-round, operator booking. DROP CANDIDATE on price ($51 cheapest, no gateway or Good Sam). Waterfront riverfront -> not waterfront proposed. Possible Ridgeview split. Equestrian-sites claim removed (only guided rides).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (price): cheapest night for 2 adults on any hookup site is $51.00 before tax (2 x $14.50 weekday family-area adult + $22 hookup; 2026 rate insert). Weekends $55, peak $59 (family) / $63 (loud). Over the $50 line by $1. No gateway within 40 km (nearest: St. Louis 111 km), not a Good Sam Park (good_sam false), and the operator posts no member discount. Stored military true comes only from the Good Sam directory - the operator's pages name no military discount.

GATES otherwise pass: presence - own site bassresort.com + (573) 786-8517 / 800-392-3700 (matches Google). Reviews - Google 4.6 (1,494), RV Life 4.0 (13). The online calendar needs a free account to see availability, but the operator's own site publishes prices and a phone, so the 2026-10-14 softened login rule keeps it. No long stays marketed.

WATERFRONT proposed DOWN riverfront -> not waterfront. The operator map (2024 PDF) puts the creekside spots in white (primitive tent) - 545-557 and 600-670 on the north bend, 101-150 and 210-233 along the east bank; the colored RV sites (full hookup, W&E, electric-only) sit one row or more back. Leaf-off Esri imagery: the north-bend RV rows (563-595, 700s) are ~45-130 m from the Courtois behind the sandy tent flats and loop roads; Island Loud Area (157-199) is ~150-250 m from the creek through woods beside a field; River Bend Family Area (234-325) is ~80-100 m from the creek behind its road and tent sites. The Courtois at the sites is ~20-30 m wide on imagery, so even its edge would be creekside, not riverfront. No pad is within a site-depth of the water. Proposed waterfront_evidence: 'Operator campground map 2024 + Esri leaf-off 2026-11-07: creek-edge sites are primitive tent sites; RV rows 45-250 m back behind tent sites/loop roads; Courtois ~20-30 m wide; no on-water RV pads'. (A riverview call is not available: the stream is under ~30 m and there is no creek-view value.)

SPLIT candidate: Ridgeview Full Hook Up RV Sites (901-931, 31 pull-throughs) are a separate area - the operator PDF gives directions from Bass' entrance: 'Follow Butts Rd until it turns into gravel. Cross low water bridge, stay to the right at the Y, continue approximately 1 mile' up Berryman Trail Road (the Y is at about 37.9915,-91.1603 per OSM), so roughly 2-3 km from the main campground with its own entrance off a public road. Not located: the Esri imagery predates it (nothing visible along Berryman Trail Road). Ridgeview is the area best suited to a 23-ft rig (pull-through, full hookup, no tent neighbours shown). If AWH wants a split, the coordinates need another source.

PIN OK: stored 37.9910,-91.1753 is on Butts Road at the resort entrance, ~170 m south of the headquarters/register office (Google 37.99246,-91.17535). Every arrival must register there first, so it is the right point.

NOTE correction: the stored note's 'also offers equestrian sites' is not supported - the site offers only guided horseback rides from its own stable; no horse camping or stalls for guests' horses are mentioned anywhere. Removed.

CRITERIA: 'Loud Area' with quiet hours only 2:30-6 am; family area quiet 11 pm-6 am. Flood warning on the map ('The campground is subject to flash flooding ... vacate the campground'). Pricing is per person, so larger parties pay more. Neither is a drop by itself.
